raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

With `--dp-size > 1` and `--load-balance-method total_tokens`, a single `/generate` request that passes `input_embeds` takes the whole server down. Such a request carries `input_ids=None`, so `len(req.input_ids)` in `total_tokens_scheduler` raises `TypeError`. The exception escapes the DP controller's `event_loop`, `run_data_parallel_controller_process` sends SIGQUIT to the parent, and every in-flight request is lost. `input_embeds` is a documented `/generate` field, so an ordinary client can hit this.

## Modifications

`total_tokens_scheduler` sizes an `input_embeds` request by its number of embedding rows, which is how the scheduler sizes it too.

An earlier version of this PR also dispatched PD requests without `bootstrap_room` round-robin instead of asserting. Reaching that path needs a client that bypasses the router, so I dropped it and kept the assert. Other exceptions in the controller still take the server down; a general reject path would need a socket back to every frontend, so this PR fixes only this trigger.

## Accuracy Tests

N/A: request dispatch only.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

N/A: no change for requests with `input_ids`.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the pre-commit hooks.
- [x] Add unit tests: `test_input_embeds_request_is_counted_by_embedding_rows` in `test/registered/unit/managers/test_data_parallel_controller.py`. On main it fails with `TypeError: object of type 'NoneType' has no len()`; with the change the file passes.
- [ ] Update documentation (not needed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style guidance.

Developed with AI assistance (Claude); every changed line was reviewed and the tests were run locally by me.

@@ -892,7 +892,10 @@ def total_requests_scheduler(self, req: Req):
     def total_tokens_scheduler(self, req: Req):
         if self.maybe_external_dp_rank_routing(req):
             return
-        estimated_tokens = len(req.input_ids)
+        # input_embeds requests carry input_ids=None.
+        estimated_tokens = (
+            len(req.input_ids) if req.input_ids is not None else len(req.input_embeds)
+        )
         target_worker = self.dp_budget.dispatch(
             LoadBalanceMethod.TOTAL_TOKENS, estimated_tokens=estimated_tokens
         )

@@ -67,14 +67,19 @@ def _req(
     input_ids=None,
     rid="USER",
     time_stats=None,
+    input_embeds=None,
 ):
-    """Req stand-in; SimpleNamespace avoids pinning to the Req dataclass schema."""
+    """Req stand-in; SimpleNamespace avoids pinning to the Req dataclass schema.
+
+    As with a real input_embeds request, passing input_embeds leaves input_ids None.
+    """
     return SimpleNamespace(
         time_stats=time_stats,
         rid=rid,
         routed_dp_rank=routed_dp_rank,
         bootstrap_room=bootstrap_room,
-        input_ids=input_ids or [],
+        input_ids=None if input_embeds is not None else (input_ids or []),
+        input_embeds=input_embeds,
     )
